title: fix(console): Flow Runs reads the served flat flow item only, and its fixtures feed that shape
body:
Fixes #12829
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Flow Runs page's `loadFlows` normalization now reads the served flat `meta.getItems('flow')` item only: `name: it?.name`, `label: it?.label`, `spec: it` (the item IS the flow definition the test runner reads `variables` from). The `it?.spec?.X ?? it?.X` arm is gone, and so is the `updatedAt ?? updated_at` read into a `FlowItem` member the page never renders (the member is dropped from the type too). How the page names a flow for users is unchanged: `label (name)`, or the bare name (PR #12828's behaviour).

Every fixture that fed the `spec`-wrapped shape now feeds the served one, in this same change:

- `FlowRunsPage.test.tsx`
- `FlowRunsPage.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`
- `developerMetadataEnvelope.contractEnvelope-6917.test.tsx` (its `FLOW` constant only)
- `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` (a fifth site the card did not list; see Acceptance notes)
- PR #12828's pin `FlowRunsPage.flattenedLabel-12783.test.tsx`: its wrapped case becomes the arm-gone pin, "a spec-wrapped item is not read: it lists no flow (objectui#12829)".

A `.changeset` with an empty frontmatter declares that nothing is released: no served shape reaches different behaviour.

## Producer census (run before any edit)

No server the console talks to serves a `spec`-wrapped flow item. The readings, by symbol, on objectstack `origin/main` at `eda6f14b7b`:

- **objectstack runtime, `GET /api/v1/meta/flow`.** `RestServer`'s list route calls `protocol.getMetaItems`, then `metaReadGate.createMetaListAnswer` (no reshaping of items). `getMetaItems` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is `readFlattenedMetaItems(..., 'served')`. Its items come from `registry.listItems` (the registered definitions themselves), the `sys_metadata` overlay rows (`convertStoredItem` of the row's `metadata` body) and `metadataService.list`, merged by `mergePackageAwareOverlay`. The answer is `{ type, items: decorateMetadataItems(type, governed), registrations }`. `decorateMetadataItem` only redacts and adds `_diagnostics`. Nowhere is an item wrapped in `spec`.
- **The runtime dispatcher's `/meta` list branch** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`) calls the same `protocol.getMetaItems` and `answerMetaList`.
- **`?preview=draft` (ADR-0033).** Same body with `previewDrafts`: draft rows are parsed from their `metadata` body and merged flat, tagged `_draft: true`.
- **`@objectstack/client` `meta.getItems`** fetches `/meta/:type` and `unwrapResponse`s it, with no item mapping.
- **Cloud runtime.** Its code is not reachable from this container, so it is NOT MEASURED. It serves through the same objectstack protocol package.
- **objectui fixture/MSW servers.** The console runs no MSW server (`@objectstack/plugin-msw` / `MSWPlugin` appear in no objectui source outside docs and evals). No non-test objectui source reads `it.spec.name` or `it.spec.label`. The only `spec`-wrapped flow items in the tree were the five test fixtures above.
- **Contract (A1).** In the installed `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2`, `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema` declares `items: z.ZodArray(z.ZodUnknown)`. `safeParse({ type: 'flow', items: [{ spec: { name: 'x' } }, { name: 'y' }, 42] })` returns `true`, so no declared contract asks for `spec`.

## Tests (at head `3b75d796ee`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 apps/console/src/pages/developer/ apps/console/src/pages/consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`: `Test Files 19 passed (19)`, `Tests 154 passed (154)`. That covers every test that names `FlowRunsPage`; the 12811 suite reads the page's source.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'`: both exit 0. The console tsconfig includes `src` with no test exclusion, so the edited tests are type-checked.
- **Ablation** (one-off, not kept). Done with `ablation-replace.mjs` after the fix commit. The `name`/`label` lines were put back to `it?.spec?.X ?? it?.X` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `0b2baeeb1ae9` to `baade6ee57d6`, `grep -c` on the injected text read 1). Result: `× a spec-wrapped item is not read: it lists no flow (objectui#12829)`, `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. The restore was proved by blob hash: the file is back to `0b2baeeb1ae9`, the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**NOT MEASURED: the whole `apps/console` package directory under `--maxWorkers=1`.** I stopped it after about 29 minutes holding the shared lock, with no file finished. CI's `pnpm test` runs it.

## Gates (exit codes)

All of these exit 0:

- `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`
- `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`
- `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`
- `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-claims.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`, `check-pending-changeset-literals.mjs`

**Lint, narrowed and proved.** The run was `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 6 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files. The JSON reports 6 files, 0 errors and 20 warnings, all `no-explicit-any` / `set-state-in-effect` in the page's existing code. The root `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project`, so type-aware linting is not enabled, and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out-of-surface fixture, fixed in place.** `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` is outside the claim's file surface. It renders `FlowRunsPage` with a `{ spec: { name: 'sync_flow', label: 'Sync' } }` fixture, so removing the arm would have left its runs-table case with no flow. It is the same defect class (a fixture in the unserved shape). The fix is the same one-line mechanical move, no other claim holds the file, and the same gate family covers it. The claim's file surface should name it.
- **Changeset.** The claim said no changeset. `check-changeset-presence` demands one for any `apps/console/src` change, because `@object-ui/console` is in the fixed group. Following the gate's message, it is the empty-frontmatter declaration.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
